content:
**Reclamation Day** is a main quest in *Fallout 76*. Its associated achievement/trophy is **Reclamation Day!**.

It is Reclamation Day for Vault 76 on October 23, 2102, and most of the Vault's dwellers have left. However, some stragglers are still in the Vault, even as of 2105. (Note) The player character is one of these holdout Vault dwellers, who has been surviving off of the remaining provisions in the Vault, which are now running out. Here, there is one item of interest that can be optionally collected: the player character's terminal contains the holotape game Nuka Tapper, which can be taken.

The quest begins after character creation, once the player character has picked up the Pip-Boy next to the door of their apartment in the Vault. Waypoints, Mister Handy attendants, and cardboard cutouts of Vault Boy will lead the player character through the Vault as the voice of the overseer plays, continuing her announcement that started prior to character creation.

Upon reaching the other end of the atrium, the objective will update from "Leave Vault 76" to "Discover the Overseer's mission," and the quest marker will lead down the hallway, passing by several stations manned by Mister Handies offering helpful survival items, to the overseer's office. Playing the holotape Overseer's log - Vault 76 on the overseer's terminal will complete this objective, and the quest objective will change back to "Leave Vault 76" and guide the player character to exit the Vault.

Items such as food, clothing, and medical items can be collected from various stands lining the path to the exit, supervised by the Mister Handy bots assigned to the Vault to watch over it after everyone has left. A projected slideshow offers a few basic tips on life above ground. Basic gameplay mechanics, including the C.A.M.P., hunger, and dehydration are explained via interaction with the various Mister Handies manning the stations.

Both investigating the overseer's office and interacting with any of the stations is optional; the overseer's log - Vault 76 holotape and all of the items given at the stations will still be automatically given to the player character upon exiting Vault 76. The C.A.M.P. will also be available even if not collected inside.

Upon walking through the Vault door, a screen will pop up for the player to choose to make their character a "Battle Ready Dweller" (immediately set to level 20, skipping early leveling, and allowed to choose a premade S.P.E.C.I.A.L. loadout for a specific playstyle) or a "Fresh Dweller" (only set to level 2, and allowed to choose one perk card). After picking one of these loadout or perk options, the player character will load into the world outside the Vault, completing the quest. The achievement Reclamation Day! will be earned after completing this quest. If a "Battle Ready Dweller" option was chosen, the achievement Wild West Virginian (reaching level 10) may also immediately be earned. Additionally, several player icons related to the S.P.E.C.I.A.L. loadouts will be unlocked and can be obtained for free from the Atomic Shop.

Wayward Souls will immediately start after this quest is completed. If a "Battle Ready Dweller" option was chosen, The New Arrivals and Welcome to the Neighborhood will also start immediately due to their level requirement being met. Beyond this, other characters and items outside the Vault can also be interacted with for leads on other side content.

Finally, there will also be a sizable amount of new items added to the inventory, in addition to any items from inside the Vault that were not collected, which will be automatically given to the player. Depending on the S.P.E.C.I.A.L. loadout or perk option chosen, some additional weapons, armor, and ammo may be received.
